      "snippet": "class TTLCache:\n    \"\"\"Clock is injected so callers can use deterministic time.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, capacity=64):\n        self.capacity = capacity\n        self.entries = OrderedDict()\n\n    def put(self, key, value, *, now, ttl):\n        if self.capacity < 1 or ttl <= 0:\n            return\n        self.entries.pop(key, None)\n        self.entries[key] = (value, now + ttl)\n        while len(self.entries) > self.capacity:\n            self.entries.popitem(last=False)\n\n    def get(self, key, *, now):\n        entry = self.entries.get(key)\n        if entry is None:\n            return None\n        value, expires = entry\n        if now > expires:\n            self.entries.pop(key, None)\n            return None\n        return value\n",

import unittest
from atlas.service import DocumentService


class SmokeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_document_lifecycle(self):
        service = DocumentService()
        document = service.repository.create("a", {"title": "Welcome"})
        self.assertEqual(document["revision"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(service.list_documents()["items"], [document])
        service.cache.put("a", document, now=0, ttl=10)
        self.assertEqual(service.cached_document("a", now=1), document)

    def test_service_helpers(self):
        service = DocumentService()
        self.assertTrue(service.authorized(["docs:read"], "docs", "read"))
        self.assertEqual(service.storage_key("/srv/data", "docs/a"), "/srv/data/docs/a")
        self.assertEqual(service.dependencies_for({"a": ["b"]}, "a"), ["b"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# Atlas document service (python)

An offline library for a document API: caching, persistence, search,
storage authorization, pagination, dependency graphs, and billing.
All time is injected. There are no credentials or network services.

Run visible smoke tests: `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.
The service module connects low-level modules to the application API.
Existing smoke tests exercise happy paths, not every boundary case.

# Development

Use this isolated checkout. Production code is in
atlas/. Run `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.
Tests must remain offline and deterministic. Preserve public interfaces.
Do not inspect or alter benchmark machinery or grading files outside
this repository. Implement fixes in source, not by weakening tests.

import unittest

from atlas.cache import TTLCache
from atlas.service import DocumentService


class TTLCacheTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_reads_before_deadline_do_not_extend_expiration(self):
        cache = TTLCache()
        cache.put("a", "value", now=100, ttl=10)

        for now in (100, 105, 109.999):
            self.assertEqual(cache.get("a", now=now), "value")
        self.assertIsNone(cache.get("a", now=110))
        self.assertNotIn("a", cache.entries)
        self.assertIsNone(cache.get("a", now=111))

    def test_first_read_after_deadline_removes_entry(self):
        cache = TTLCache()
        cache.put("a", "value", now=100, ttl=10)

        self.assertIsNone(cache.get("a", now=111))
        self.assertNotIn("a", cache.entries)

    def test_overwrite_starts_new_ttl(self):
        cache = TTLCache()
        cache.put("a", "old", now=100, ttl=10)
        cache.put("a", "new", now=105, ttl=20)

        self.assertEqual(cache.get("a", now=110), "new")
        self.assertEqual(cache.get("a", now=124.999), "new")
        self.assertIsNone(cache.get("a", now=125))
        self.assertNotIn("a", cache.entries)

    def test_document_service_expires_cached_document_at_deadline(self):
        service = DocumentService()
        document = service.repository.create("a", {"title": "Welcome"})
        service.cache.put("a", document, now=100, ttl=10)

        self.assertEqual(service.cached_document("a", now=109), document)
        self.assertIsNone(service.cached_document("a", now=110))
        self.assertNotIn("a", service.cache.entries)
        self.assertIsNone(service.cached_document("a", now=111))

from atlas.service import DocumentService


class SmokeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_document_lifecycle(self):
        service = DocumentService()
        document = service.repository.create("a", {"title": "Welcome"})
        self.assertEqual(document["revision"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(service.list_documents()["items"], [document])
        service.cache.put("a", document, now=0, ttl=10)
        self.assertEqual(service.cached_document("a", now=1), document)

    def test_service_helpers(self):
        service = DocumentService()
        self.assertTrue(service.authorized(["docs:read"], "docs", "read"))
        self.assertEqual(service.storage_key("/srv/data", "docs/a"), "/srv/data/docs/a")
        self.assertEqual(service.dependencies_for({"a": ["b"]}, "a"), ["b"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
